title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21
taper: Thanks to Dr. Bruce Fried for lending me his dat.

ai_review.summary: Clean matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1973 show with tight Jack Straw, a soaring Let It Grow jam and a perfect Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its loose‑Lucy swagger, an exploratory Here Comes Sunshine, a tight Jack Straw opening, an amazing Let It Grow jam and a flawless Black Peter. Reviewers note the matrix source is clean and well balanced, though one mentions a slightly dragged ending to Let It Grow and a cut‑off intro on Sing Your Blues. Overall the show feels high‑energy and quintessentially 1973.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (average 4★) and highlight excellent matrix sound quality, while a single low‑star review points out minor performance issues; combined weighting yields a strong 4.4 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, balanced mix noted as "clean, balanced" by reviewers; matrix source combines soundboard clarity with audience ambience. No major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard first set with a rare Black Peter addition; second set flows through horns‑enhanced numbers and tight transitions, highlighted by an expansive Let It Grow jam.
